example.title: Ruins of barn and silo, Derwood

brief: Abandoned glazed hollow clay tile silo about 14 ft across and 36 ft high, the glazed blocks mottled plum, rust and brown and glinting in the sun, a vertical door slot up one side and a ragged open top. The barn it served has collapsed into a low rubble mound of stone foundation and timbers at its foot; a grove of bare young trees and brush has grown up around it beside a roadside field. (Here the silo still stands beside the working barn but is long disused.)
